name: contrastapi
description: Security intelligence MCP server for CVEs, packages, domains and IP addresses. Look up and triage CVEs with EPSS, CISA KEV, CWE, exploit references and a composite risk score; check packages against OSV.dev and the OpenSSF malicious package list; check a domain's DNS, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, TLS, security headers, WHOIS, certificate transparency and subdomains; look up IPs and ASNs. A watch list follows the same items and reports what changed: KEV and EPSS moves, new exploits and advisories, DNS, TLS and certificate changes. Free tier without an API key.
